Team —

Quick perf notes from the harness run against the 12k corpus (summary):
- Embedding throughput: 3.2k docs/hour on a single c5-gpu instance when batching at 128; with batching at 256 we see 4.8k docs/hour but 95th pct latency increases ~40%.
- Search latency (retrieval + rerank): median end-to-end 120ms, p95 340ms (under test load).
- Recommended config for pilot: quantized LLM variant + batch=128, KV cache enabled for interactive sessions.

I uploaded the detailed output and the test harness logs to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_MAP_Analytica (folder: perf-reports).

I'll add a short slide (3–4 bullets) to the MAP sheet with these recommendations.

Marissa
